purpose: Qualify opt-in snapshot-local interval decoding and real self-restores on one deliberately reused existing route; no search.
decisions: Default and area summary/trace bytes must equal their NQ01 counterparts exactly.
Context modes preserve every old summary value except added fields and trace byte counts. Dropping new trace columns reproduces NQ01 area bytes exactly.
Context and restore modes have identical retained trace bytes and all-frame raw/context hashes, endpoints and interval counts. Only the explicit restore count/qualification mode differs.
Each self-restore verifies same-boundary raw bytes and seeds a fresh baseline. Exactly floor((127003-1)/4096)=31 restores per one-frame pass are expected.
Python independently decodes native retained contexts and agrees with the native interval outputs on consecutive retained rows.
Any mismatch stops qualification and development-tape dispatch. No implicit retry or new search.
resource_note: Four independent qualification cases on idle msr1 CPUs 4-7 concurrently; at most 4 GiB each, 300 seconds per service, 32 MiB per trace. No speed comparison.
